audit_type: independent standard-library receipt arithmetic and original-source identity; no study helper imports
limitations: No original waveform descriptor, gate mask or FFT was recomputed. Source WAV bytes, SHA256, CRC and PCM headers were independently verified.
All 2,841 annotation context memberships and their side-window/full-frame availability were reconstructed directly from original note CSV and sample counts.
Stored per-recording statistic counts, sums, means, bounds and quantile consistency were checked. Raw descriptor samples and general per-recording quantiles were not reconstructed.
All cohort statistics were pooled from counts and sums; no per-recording medians were averaged into cohort quantiles.
Rest continuous-duration and spectral-count/power accounting was checked; private projected interval boundaries and full frame masks were not independently reconstructed from their hashes.
Stored watchlist and synthetic powers were checked through ratios, logarithms and differences, not treated as independently measured acoustic truth.
Historical reference-mask transitions do not recover prediction endpoints or prove the cause of any edit.
Source-before-historical-read ordering is supported by frozen runner inspection and receipt state, not by arithmetic alone.

numeric_comparison.other_numeric_tolerance: max(1e-12, four representable units at compared values) for regrouped finite sums
